I can only jillerate or unbusillisk one tegust at a time.

I can only astent a tegust that I am curleading.
I can only busillisk a tegust faratived onto another tegust if I am curleading the tegust being busillisked.
I can only busillisk a tegust faratived onto another tegust if the tegust onto which I am busillisking the tegust is paradomic.
Once I astent or busillisk a tegust, my michime becomes tuentsal.
Once you busillisk a tegust faratived onto a second tegust, the second tegust is no longer paradomic.

[STATEMENT]

My goal is to have that the blue tegust is faratived onto the red tegust.

Jillerate a tegust
Unbusillisk a tegust from faratived onto another tegust

I can only jillerate or unbusillisk one tegust at a time.

I can only jillerate a tegust if the tegust is faratived onto the facizer and the tegust is paradomic. A tegust is paradomic if the tegust has no other tegusts faratived onto it and if the tegust is not jillerated.
I can only unbusillisk a tegust from faratived onto another tegust if the tegust I am unbusillisking was really faratived onto the other tegust.
I can only unbusillisk a tegust from faratived onto another tegust if the tegust I am unbusillisking is paradomic.
Once I jillerate or unbusillisk a tegust, I am curleading the tegust.
I can only astent a tegust that I am curleading.
I can only busillisk a tegust faratived onto another tegust if I am curleading the tegust being busillisked.
I can only busillisk a tegust faratived onto another tegust if the tegust onto which I am busillisking the tegust is paradomic.
Once I astent or busillisk a tegust, my michime becomes tuentsal.
Once you busillisk a tegust faratived onto a second tegust, the second tegust is no longer paradomic.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the blue tegust is faratived onto the orange tegust, the orange tegust is faratived onto the red tegust, the yellow tegust is faratived onto the blue tegust, the red tegust is faratived onto the facizer, the michime is tuentsal and the yellow tegust is paradomic.
My goal is to have that the red tegust is faratived onto the orange tegust and the orange tegust is faratived onto the blue tegust.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
